title: The AI Hypocrisy Index (Dataset)
description:
Data behind The AI Hypocrisy Index, a HasData study of the gap between what companies forbid in their Terms of Service and what they claim over user and public data.

The sample is 35 companies that build AI models or operate crawlers (Tier A) and the 150 most-visited consumer websites from the Tranco ranking, list 94Y82 (Tier B). Terms of Service, Privacy Policies (Tier A only) and robots.txt files were fetched on July 23, 2026, with archived Wayback Machine versions for context. Each document was classified against a 12-clause taxonomy of 7 anti-scraping and 5 extraction clauses, and every reported clause carries a verbatim quote verified as an exact substring of the fetched text. 402 quotes passed that check.

This release ships the Index with its forbid and take scores for every Tier A company, all 402 verified quotes, every clause check on current and archived documents, the robots.txt rules of 197 domains for 26 crawler user agents, a crawler registry, the document hashes, and three standard-library Python scripts that recompute the study's checks. Raw document texts are not included.
